message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and of course, my friend who panics at the slightest change was convinced we were in for a week in the dark. I just pulled out my trusty flashlight and power bank, and we ended up playing board games by lantern light, laughing about how much we love snacks that don’t need cooking. Sometimes, a little prep can turn a worry into a fun memory! Have you had a blackout that turned into a laugh?
